acceptance_criteria: Independent actual tests of protected ROM checker using official SP semantics and real rejected R3; accept expected lanes through supported fixture, reject mapping/init mutations; precise limits and protected inputs unchanged.
prompt: Read CONTRACT.md, rom_check.py and official SP context. Implement the independent tests and evidence report only in your owned files. Run official taskbox_run_tests before editing and after your last edit. Use tools and actual assertions; do not modify protected decoder, fabricate outcomes, or perform hardware/network operations. Preserve a precise failing counterexample if the decoder is wrong rather than changing expectations.
